harsh_training_session.title: The Breaking Point
harsh_training_session.description: [initiator_name] has been pushing their training regimen to its absolute limit for the past two weeks. Their body trembles at the verge of exhaustion — or transformation.

opt_push_further.text: Train harder. The breakthrough is close.

effects.text: I pushed my body beyond its limits. Whether this forges me or breaks me remains to be seen.

opt_rest_and_recover.text: Rest and consolidate. The path is long.

effects.text: I chose rest over recklessness. Steady progress is still progress.

secret_technique_discovered.title: The Hidden Scroll
secret_technique_discovered.description: [initiator_name] discovers a hidden compartment in the sect library containing a scroll written in an archaic cipher. The title reads: 'Seven-Step Soul Shattering Palm'.

opt_study_immediately.text: Begin deciphering it at once. Knowledge waits for no one.

effects.text: I found a forbidden scroll and began studying it immediately.

opt_report_to_master.text: Report it to the Sect Master. Forbidden techniques need oversight.

effects.text: I turned the hidden scroll over to the Sect Master. Honor before power.
A loyal disciple of [initiator_sect_name] reported a forbidden scroll to their master.

sparring_accident.title: Steel Meets Flesh
sparring_accident.description: During a supervised sparring match, [initiator_name]'s technique slipped and they struck their partner with real force. The partner is injured, the match has ended, and the training ground is silent.

opt_apologise_publicly.text: Bow and apologise openly. It was an accident.

effects.text: I apologised publicly for my error. It cost me face, but it was the right thing.

opt_deflect_blame.text: Claim the partner was careless in their guard.

effects.text: I redirected the blame. Survival in this sect demands self-preservation.
